title: Capability Manifest
description: Declares a single capability that a partner is registering with HUBVERY.

capability_id.description: Stable, partner-assigned identifier for this capability. Must be unique within the partner's namespace.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the capability registry.

description.description: Short description of what this capability does.

version.description: Semantic version of this capability manifest.

modality.description: Primary input/output modality of this capability.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema describing valid task input for this capability.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the result payload this capability returns on success.

constraints.description: Operational limits HUBVERY should respect when routing tasks to this capability.

auth_scopes.description: OAuth2 scopes required to submit a task to this capability.
